marks.gloss_en: for the fine Rebbi concedes all pay as for a virgin (מודה רבי לענין קנס); the capital difference is the decree ומת האיש אשר שכב עמה לבדו -- only the first dies by stoning
R. Zeira: Rebbi concedes that for the FINE all ten pay as for a virgin -- so his strangulation ruling is not because another renders her a non-virgin
the two are not executed unless both are equal as one (both punishable)
